item.text: {"mappings":[{"alignment":"DIFFERENT_OR_UNENCODED_QUESTION","assumptions":["The supplied classifications and factual stipulations are true.","No later amendment or other applicable authority displaces the selected clause."],"candidate_id":"reading.complex_classification","case_id":"26ec55.equal.threshold","facts":[],"rationale":"The case asks whether the express quantitative threshold classifies the fund. That is one subcondition. The unchanged program asks whether either the quantitative threshold or an operative SFC designation establishes classification. Agreement in this stipulated scenario does not make these precisely the same Boolean question.","source_evidence":[{"quote":"A Fund will be considered as a complex product if its total direct and indirect exposures to private market assets amount to 50% or more of the Fund’s NAV.","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u21.3779"}]},{"alignment":"NEGATED_BOOLEAN_QUESTION","assumptions":["The supplied classifications and factual stipulations are true.","No later amendment or other applicable authority displaces the selected clause.","Non-complex under this circular is read narrowly as absence of both encoded classification grounds; definitely requires those absences to be established."],"candidate_id":"reading.complex_classification","case_id":"26ec55.below.no.designation.evidence","facts":[{"name":"sfc_public_fund","rationale":"The scenario expressly stipulates the same type of in-scope SFC-authorised fund.","status":"KNOWN","value":"true"},{"name":"is_laf","rationale":"The stipulated in-scope fund is of the same type as the preceding fund, expressly excluding listed closed-ended alternative asset funds.","status":"KNOWN","value":"false"},{"name":"aggregate_exposure_at_least_half_nav","rationale":"The stipulated aggregate exposure is 49.9% of NAV, below 50%.","status":"KNOWN","value":"false"},{"name":"effective_sfc_designation","rationale":"The scenario expressly leaves whether an SFC case-specific designation exists unestablished. Missing evidence does not establish absence.","status":"UNKNOWN","value":null}],"rationale":"Within the stipulated scope, absence of both classification grounds is the negation of the program's disjunction. The threshold ground is false, but designation remains unknown, so both the classification result and its negation remain unresolved. The program cannot establish definite non-complexity.","source_evidence":[{"quote":"On a case-by-case basis, the SFC may also designate a Fund as a complex product, taking into account factors including, without limitation:","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u21.3779"},{"quote":"In assessing whether the complex product designation is warranted7, the SFC will adopt a holistic approach taking into account the specific circumstances of the case.","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u29.4630"}]},{"alignment":"DIFFERENT_OR_UNENCODED_QUESTION","assumptions":["The supplied classifications and factual stipulations are true.","No later amendment or other applicable authority displaces the selected clause."],"candidate_id":"reading.complex_classification","case_id":"26ec55.excluded.laf","facts":[],"rationale":"The case asks whether this circular establishes classification for an expressly excluded vehicle. The program's classification predicate is conditional on being in scope; exclusion produces no classification result and cannot be converted into a false result. Applicability to the excluded vehicle is a different question.","source_evidence":[{"quote":"6 Except for listed closed-ended alternative asset funds (LAFs). For LAFs, please refer to the circular on LAFs: https://apps.sfc.hk/edistributionWeb/gateway/EN/circular/products/product-authorization/doc?refNo=25EC9","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u63.8691"}]},{"alignment":"DIFFERENT_OR_UNENCODED_QUESTION","assumptions":["The supplied classifications and factual stipulations are true.","No later amendment or other applicable authority displaces the selected clause."],"candidate_id":"reading.complex_classification","case_id":"26ec55.no.solicitation","facts":[],"rationale":"The question concerns the suitability obligation following classification when no solicitation or recommendation occurs. The program encodes classification grounds, not the resulting sales obligations. Its narrative discussion of suitability does not encode this question.","source_evidence":[{"quote":"A Fund classified as a complex product will be subject to the SFC’s prevailing requirements for the sale of complex products8 including but not limited to ensuring the suitability of the Fund for its investors irrespective of whether solicitation or recommendation is involved.","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u32.4805"}]}],"unresolved":["For 26ec55.below.no.designation.evidence, operative SFC designation status remains unknown; neither classification nor absence of both grounds is established.","Temporal applicability and the applicable exposure measurement basis remain conditional as stated in the candidate; the stipulated percentages do not independently resolve the circular's general timing or measurement uncertainties."]}
